Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 20

“One should neither rejoice on obtaining the pleasant nor be disturbed on obtaining the unpleasant. Steady in understanding and undeluded, the knower of Brahman is established in Brahman.”

Note what is not asked for — the pleasant and unpleasant still keep arriving. Krishna targets the reaction, not the circumstances, which is the only part actually available.
